From industry leading post-harvest quality and freshness solutions to digital technology platforms
that answer your unique challenges, we’re 100% focused on what fresh means to you. As the pioneers
behind the introduction of 1-MCP for ethylene management, as well as Uvasys, the world’s first

[Learn More][71]

## Answers from all angles.

We have leading near- and post-harvest products and services that answer real quality and freshness

  ## [SmartFresh Extends Shelf Life and Strengthens Post-Harvest Confidence][109]
  
  SmartFresh is helping apple producers move beyond traditional storage limitations and deliver
  consistently high-quality fruit to market. As Marcelo Gaete Yanten, Head of Growers and New

  application, SmartFresh, [we were] able to move away from relying solely on controlled atmosphere
  storage, [...]
  
  [Read More][110]

  May 7th, 2026
  
  ## [SmartFresh Elevates Apple Quality and Market Reach][112]
  
  SmartFresh is transforming apple post-harvest performance by helping growers maintain quality and
  expand market opportunities. As one expert notes, “SmartFresh helped solve many of the major
  post-harvest challenges in apples worldwide,” while also “completely transform[ing] apple
  post-harvest management and, ultimately, the business itself.” For producers like Jose Monasterio

## Innovation in motion.

Advancing freshness technology. Investing more in R&D. Partnering that opens new possibilities.
Answering questions before they become problems. Innovation takes many forms and AgroFresh puts them
all in motion to empower the business of fresh.

  solutions that help elevate produce quality, extend shelf life, and drive sustainable growth

* [ [The Strait of Hormuz A Geopolitical Bottleneck Testing the Resilience of the Fresh Produce

  May 21st, 2026
  
  ## [The Strait of Hormuz: A Geopolitical Bottleneck Testing the Resilience of the Fresh Produce
  ## Industry][119]
  
  Growing geopolitical tensions surrounding the Strait of Hormuz are once again highlighting the
  enormous logistical fragility of the international fruit and vegetable supply chain. While much of
  the public debate focuses on oil, fuel and energy-related impacts, the fresh produce sector faces
  a quieter but particularly serious threat: time.   In the fresh produce trade, [...]
  
  [Read More][120]
* [ [AgroFresh Opens New Asia Pacific R&D Center in Yangling, China] ][121]
  April 24th, 2026
  
  ## [AgroFresh Opens New Asia Pacific R&D Center in Yangling, China][122]
  
  The journey of fresh produce powered by AgroFresh. Science. Solutions. Sustainability.   YANGLING,
  Shaanxi, China – April 28, 2026 – AgroFresh Solutions Inc., a global leader in post-harvest
  solutions, today opened its new Asia Pacific Research & Development Center in Yangling—China’s
  premier agricultural innovation hub.   The center represents AgroFresh’s continued investment in
  fresh produce [...]

# Welcome to Citrus Australia

Citrus Australia is the prescribed peak industry body (PIB) for the Australian citrus industry. To
help our growers and our industry succeed, we focus on core activities and are guided by values that
underpin everything we do.

The citrus industry is geographically diverse; there are complexities in domestic, export and juice
markets. Citrus Australia recognises this and in our advocacy work we push for the best result for
all Australian growers.

# Welcome to Citrus Australia

Citrus Australia is the prescribed peak industry body (PIB) for the Australian citrus industry. To
help our growers and our industry succeed, we focus on core activities and are guided by values that
underpin everything we do.

The citrus industry is geographically diverse; there are complexities in domestic, export and juice
markets. Citrus Australia recognises this and in our advocacy work we push for the best result for
all Australian growers.

[ Find out more about Citrus Austrlaia ][86]

# Welcome to Citrus Australia

Citrus Australia is the prescribed peak industry body (PIB) for the Australian citrus industry. To
help our growers and our industry succeed, we focus on core activities and are guided by values that
underpin everything we do.

The citrus industry is geographically diverse; there are complexities in domestic, export and juice
markets. Citrus Australia recognises this and in our advocacy work we push for the best result for
all Australian growers.

Food Supply Chain Solutions

## A worldwide leader in cold storage and logistics

[Warehouse exterior photo]
Global Warehousing

Our network of sophisticated, strategically located cold storage facilities offers comprehensive and
innovative solutions for protecting your temperature-controlled products.

[EXPLORE][95]
[Transportation photo of a truck in at the port]
Global Integrated Solutions

Strengthen the links between your supply chain with our Global Integrated Solutions. From import and
export services to transportation and fulfillment, we power more connected supply chains.

[EXPLORE][96]
[Frozen food aisle in a grocery store featuring glass-door freezers stocked with packaged meals and
frozen goods.]
Disruptions Lose
The Race Against Tariffs
Lineage helped a Canadian food manufacturer beat tariff deadlines with fast cross-border logistics,
storage near the U.S. border, and real-time visibility.
[Read the Full Case Study][97]
[Aerial view of a busy shipping port at dusk, with rows of colorful cargo containers, large
container cranes and a lit-up city skyline in the background.]
Disruptions don’t wait
Avoiding port chaos when $10M is on the line
When a port labor strike stalled nearly 50 refrigerated containers, Lineage activated its East Coast
network to clear freight fast, protect high-value seafood and keep product moving despite the
disruption.
[Read the Full Case Study][98]
[Lineage data scientist reviewing a U.S. supply chain network map with transportation routes
visualized for optimization analysis.]
Data-driven decisions
Turning supply chain data into $2M in annual savings
When capacity issues created bottlenecks, Lineage analyzed the customer’s network to redesign
distribution and unlock smarter, more scalable operations.
[Read the Full Case Study][99]
[Microscopic image of algal cells, representing specialty cold chain storage and handling for algal
oils and biomass products at Lineage]
Built for complexity
Creating the right conditions for specialty cold chain needs
When a specialty customer needed compliant cold storage for hazmat-classified products, Lineage
customized facilities, training and certifications to safely support their cold chain from day one.
[Read the Full Case Study][100]

# Produce Management Solutions for Foodservice Leaders

High performance custom produce solutions backed by $3B+  in buying power, 450+ growers, and a
trusted network of 150+ specialty distributors — powered by tech, built for foodservice.

[ Get started ][24]
[ What we do ][25]
[Group 3]

## Who we are

Produce Alliance delivers customized produce management programs through a trusted network of
growers and specialty distributors. With decades of experience and a commitment to food safety,
innovation, and long-term partnerships, we help foodservice brands streamline their supply chains
and serve with confidence.

[ More about us ][26]
100 +

## Premium Growers

$ 0 B+

## In buying power

10 K+

## Foodservice Partners

100 +

## Hand-Picked Distributors

## Why Produce Alliance

## High Performance Produce Management

We combine deep industry knowledge, powerful partnerships, and innovative tools to deliver produce
procurement that’s smarter, safer, and more reliable—we call this high performance produce
management.

## Expertise & Customization

Every produce program is tailored to your needs, whether you’re starting fresh or building on
existing supplier relationships. Our team of experts in produce sourcing, food safety, and logistics
provides hands-on support, with a dedicated account executive to streamline communication and build
long-term success.

## Scale & Network Power

With a coast-to-coast and global network of growers and specialty distributors, we deliver
consistent, high quality supply at the price you need. Our scale minimizes disruptions and supports
growth, giving multi-unit operators a reliable, scalable partner.

## Technology & Safety

We integrate powerful tools that give you visibility into spend, performance, and planning. From
real-time reporting to traceability compliance, we help you make smarter decisions with greater
confidence.

## What we do

## Everything you need in one partner

Comprehensive end-to-end produce solutions—from procurement and enhanced forecasting and planning to
exceptional quality and industry-leading food safety standards—delivering unmatched support at every
stage.

[Procurement][27]

PA’s team of over 50 procurement professionals—spanning five strategic offices and including
contract managers, category specialists, analysts, compliance, and logistics experts—collaborates to
deliver unmatched support.

[Supply Chain & Distribution][28]

PA works with 150+ distributor partners and provides comprehensive supply chain management
solutions, from procurement and logistics to compliance and analytics, ensuring seamless, end-to-end
support for clients.

[Food Safety & Compliance][29]

Protect your brand and meet regulatory requirements with our industry-leading food safety programs
and traceability systems.

[Technology & Business Intelligence][30]

Backed by industry-leading technology, PA offers a comprehensive back-office platform that
integrates robust reporting, advanced analytics, and streamlined ordering to empower clients with
real-time insights and operational efficiency.

[Client Success Management][31]

PA assigns a dedicated Account Executive to each client, backed by a team of specialists, ensuring
personalized service and a single point of contact for fast, efficient support.

## 50,000+ foodservice partners served nationwide

# Farmers for our future.

Farming has always been about feeding communities and nurturing the land. Today, this remains the
goal of millions of hard-working farmers worldwide. Technology is opening new horizons for them,
allowing them to produce more food with less resources, a vital goal in a planet with growing needs.
Our Farmer-First strategy is about understanding farmers’ pain points so we can better serve them. 

[ 2025 Annual Report ][84] [ 2025 Sustainability Suite ][85]
[Together, we’re helping change the world for good.]

## Legacies of the Land

A U.S. campaign honoring 250 years of farming heritage**
American farming families have shaped the land for generations.**

*Legacies of the Land* brings their stories forward — told in their own words, on the farms they
call home.

[ Watch the stories ][86]
[Fendt RoGator 600 Series]

## A proud portfolio of legendary brands.

AGCO's leading brands support farmers as they transform the agricultural industry. Our innovative
solutions and a Farmer-First mentality are changing the landscape for farmers across the world.

[ View our brands ][87]
[Sowing with a Fendt ]

## Sowing the seeds of ingenuity.

AGCO's precision technologies are revolutionizing the way we farm the land. By harnessing the power
of innovation, farmers can now achieve higher yields with fewer resources.

# Farmers for our future.

Farming has always been about feeding communities and nurturing the land. Today, this remains the
goal of millions of hard-working farmers worldwide. Technology is opening new horizons for them,
allowing them to produce more food with less resources, a vital goal in a planet with growing needs.
Our Farmer-First strategy is about understanding farmers’ pain points so we can better serve them. 

[ 2025 Annual Report ][84] [ 2025 Sustainability Suite ][85]
[Together, we’re helping change the world for good.]

## Legacies of the Land

A U.S. campaign honoring 250 years of farming heritage**
American farming families have shaped the land for generations.**

*Legacies of the Land* brings their stories forward — told in their own words, on the farms they
call home.

[ Watch the stories ][86]
[Fendt RoGator 600 Series]

## A proud portfolio of legendary brands.

AGCO's leading brands support farmers as they transform the agricultural industry. Our innovative
solutions and a Farmer-First mentality are changing the landscape for farmers across the world.

[ View our brands ][87]
[Sowing with a Fendt ]

## Sowing the seeds of ingenuity.

AGCO's precision technologies are revolutionizing the way we farm the land. By harnessing the power
of innovation, farmers can now achieve higher yields with fewer resources.

## Revolutionizing the farmer experience, online and onsite.

FarmerCore introduces more convenience for farmers by bringing the entire business to the farm,

[ FarmerCore ][91]
[Silhouette of farmer in field]

## Today’s challenges are tomorrow’s possibilities.

Our purpose at AGCO is to provide farmer-focused solutions to sustainably feed our world. Our
ambition is to accelerate innovation and efficiency to drive positive outcomes for farmers and the
planet.

## AGCO. Where extraordinary grows.

Not everyone can claim to feed the world, but it is part of our every day. Behind everything we do
for our farmers, there is one AGCO team making it happen. We are proud to put our curiosity to work,
building a better and more sustainable world. Join us! 

[ Careers ][98]
[ [AGCO - Your Agriculture Company - Red and white logo] ][99]
AGCO (NYSE: AGCO) is a global leader in agricultural machinery and precision agriculture
technologies.

Driven by a Farmer-First strategy, AGCO delivers value through its differentiated leading brands,
Fendt™, Massey Ferguson™, PTx™ and Valtra™.  AGCO’s high-performance equipment and smart farming
solutions, including brand-agnostic retrofit technologies and autonomous offerings, empower farmers
to drive productivity while sustainably feeding the world.

# Manufacturer of World Class 100% Pure & Natural Essential Oils, Resins, Perfume Oils and Fragrance
# Oils

Since our inception in the year 1990, the primary objective of BMV has been to passionately work
towards the creation of a nature friendly environment. BMV is one of the well known manufacturers,
exporters and suppliers of pure essential oils, aroma oils, perfume oils and fragrance oils across
the perfumery industry as a company true to its authenticity and values with every step marked by
creativity and innovation. BMV Fragrances believes in the power of knowledge and commitment for the
satisfaction of our customers across the globe. With a combined experience of more than 87 years and
our continuous and intensive research in the field of [**natural essential oils**][42] and
[**perfumery materials**][43] has enabled us to know our client's needs better for essential oils
and constantly strive to meet their expectations.

This fusion of knowledge, affinity towards nature and creativity has made us one of the largest
producers of essential oils, resin, [**synthetic essential oil**][44], [**reconstitutions**][45] and
[**perfumery bases**][46], perfume oils. We provide [**100% pure essential oils in wholesale**][47],
including Fragrance Oils, Perfume Oils, Aromatherapy Oils, resin manufacturing, along with
Reconstitution Oils and Specialities to different industries. Our top-quality product range has made
us an approved supplier, manufacturer, and trusted brand in wholesaling of essential oils, synthetic
essential oils, fragrance oils and [**resins manufacturer**][48].

We welcome all your requirements of 100% natural, pure & natural essential oils, [**perfume
oils**][49] and [**fragrance oils**][50]. Every single day our team of researchers and innovators
set out to bring a new variety of pure and natural or reconstitutions of oils, synthetic essential
oils, [**resinoids**][51], absolutes and [**perfumery bases**][52] to the shelves to deliver to our
valued customers. We not only make sure that we improve the variety but also maintain the highest
quality of all our products which always live beyond the expectations of our clients. We have a firm
determination to deliver the best products as per our commitments to client satisfaction.

# Collection of custom scripts

[Examples of visualizations]

This repository contains a collection of custom scripts for [Sentinel Hub][47], which can be fed to
the services via the URL.

Custom scripts are a piece of Javascript code, used to visualize satellite imagery and to control
what values the Sentinel Hub services will return. Any visualization of any constellation (e.g.
Sentinel-2 satellite), even a simple true color composite, is dictated by a custom script.

## Contribute

You are invited to publish your own scripts. For this see the section [Contribute][48]. See also the
[documentation page][49] for custom scripts.

## Navigation

Navigate the webpage with the sidebar on the left. The sidebar provides custom scripts split up by
satellite sensors.

Alternatively you can also use the search bar at the top to look for custom scripts that might be of
interest to you (try typing in `fire` or `NDVI` for example).

## Relevant reading

* [Color Correction with JavaScript][51] (by Miha Kadunc)

  Milcinski)

* [Educational Role of EO Browser and New Features][55] (by Sabina Dolenc)
* [Environmental Monitoring of Conflicts using Sentinel-2 data][56] (by Wim Zwijnenburg)
* [Why Newsrooms need People with Expertise in Remote Sensing][57] (by Pierre Markuse)
* [Active Volcanoes as Seen from Space][58] (by Sabina Dolenc)
* [Get Creative and Solve a Remote Sensing Problem at Home from your PC and Win!][59] (by Grega
  Milcinski)
* [Measuring Air Pollution from Space][60] (by Sabina Dolenc)
* [Mapping deforestation with Sentinel Hub][61] (by Nicolas Karasiak)
* [Why join the next Sentinel Hub Custom Script Contest][62] (by Sabina Dolenc)

# Collection of custom scripts

[Examples of visualizations]

This repository contains a collection of custom scripts for [Sentinel Hub][47], which can be fed to
the services via the URL.

Custom scripts are a piece of Javascript code, used to visualize satellite imagery and to control
what values the Sentinel Hub services will return. Any visualization of any constellation (e.g.
Sentinel-2 satellite), even a simple true color composite, is dictated by a custom script.

## Contribute

You are invited to publish your own scripts. For this see the section [Contribute][48]. See also the
[documentation page][49] for custom scripts.

## Navigation

Navigate the webpage with the sidebar on the left. The sidebar provides custom scripts split up by
satellite sensors.

Alternatively you can also use the search bar at the top to look for custom scripts that might be of
interest to you (try typing in `fire` or `NDVI` for example).

# Supplying Bulk Ingredients By The Pallet, Truckload, and Container

Bulk Ingredients, industrial ingredient sourcing, negotiating, transporting, and delivering the bulk
industrial ingredients you need from our vast worldwide networks - foodguys is your one-stop-shop!
We have the resources and expertise to provide you with all-encompassing ingredient solutions to
your industrial ingredient needs. is a bulk ingredient supplier for manufacturers in the food and
beverage (human-grade, baby, and pet food), personal care, beauty, and nutraceutical industry. In
addition, foodguys works with retailers, distributors, food service operators to provide bulk
ingredient sourcing, ingredient solutions, and streamline processes related to ingredient
procurement, transportation, and storage. 


It is our job as foodguys to make your job easier.


Think of it this way: foodguys has been doing this since '91, and in that time we have established
relationships and networks that span the entire globe. We have rock-solid relationships with
vendors, transportation, warehouses, and most importantly, a team that truly understands the process
from start to finish.


Our resources allow us to pass high-volume/low-cost per unit order prices on to you. Our MOQs with
our partners begin at one pallet (2,000 lbs). And the best part? We consider ourselves part of your
team, so we will actively seek out additional ways for your organization to improve.

About Freshdi
Freshdi is a global B2B marketplace powered by AI.By integrating AI across the entire journey,
Freshdi enables suppliers and buyers worldwide to connect quickly, easily, and reliably - in just
only three steps: listing products, smart matching & trade connecting.
What makes Freshdi different?
Unlike traditional B2B platforms, Freshdi is built as an AI-driven marketplace, optimized for global
sourcing and export success in the digital age.
What documents are needed for the verified badge?
To earn the Verified Badge on Freshdi, submit one of the following: Business Registration
Certificate, Tax Registration Document, or Official Address Proof. Verification boosts your
credibility and attracts more buyer inquiries. [View more][1]
How can I improve my chances of finding buyers?
To enhance the efficiency of finding and connecting with buyers, list your products, complete
verification, send quotations, respond quickly to inquiries, and connect with buyers on the HOT and
NEW tab. Building global trade relationships takes consistent effort - we recommend committing at
least 4 months and investing in a Premium profile to stand out. [View more][2]
Are the buyers and suppliers listed here trustworthy?
Freshdi filters out suspicious profiles through verification services, but we are not a verification
agency. Users should still conduct independent checks and use trusted sources like embassies or
third-party agencies. Face-to-face meetings are highly recommended to reduce risks. [View more][3]
What are the benefits of the Premium Plan?
The Premium Plan helps you scale faster and connect with more serious buyers: stay on top of search
results, get fast access to inquiries, build trust with a detailed profile and product portfolio,
appear on the homepage and buyer emails, and stand out as a Premium Supplier. [View more][4]

sourcing and export success in the digital age.
What documents are needed for the verified badge?

How can I improve my chances of finding buyers?
To enhance the efficiency of finding and connecting with buyers, list your products, complete

least 4 months and investing in a Premium profile to stand out. [View more][2]

results, get fast access to inquiries, build trust with a detailed profile and product portfolio,
